author: cheeemahh

title: Feature suggestion 🙂
body: Absolutely love Tasks and use it to track my productivity in all my engagements. I’d love it even more if there was an archive though. I don’t want to have to delete a list just because I’ve completed all tasks on it. Also, I want to be able to reorder all my lists on mobile so that I can have the one I’m cutting working on upfront without having to scroll all the way to the end of the row, just because it’s the list I created last.

title: Synchronize google calendar and tasks for mobile
body:
Hello, I love google but I find it strange that google calendar and tasks do not function together on mobile.
 I don’t see my curated tasks on the mobile calendar. It quite goes against what google stands for -ease of access, don’t you think so?
Please fix it. There’s a whole community of humans that needs this feature
